objective: Implement the core foundation for the Snowflake Cost Management accelerator by binding the idle-warehouse-waste dataForge snapshot to a dashForge DashboardSpec, presenting prioritized recommendations, and proving DashboardSpec and DataAdapter runtime seams using deterministic micro-steps without modifying underlying generative contracts.

journeys.name: Generate deterministic idle warehouse waste SQLite database and provenance-labeled JSON snapshot
journeys.goal: An author or consultant generates a deterministic Snowflake cost database and JSON snapshot for the idle-warehouse-waste scenario using seed 9101, producing reproducible SQLite tables, canonical snapshot datasets, and rich provenance metadata for an executive buyer demo.
commands: env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack snowflakeCost --scenario idle-warehouse-waste --seed 9101 --output /tmp/idle-warehouse-waste.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/idle-warehouse-waste.snapshot.json --force
steps: Execute env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack snowflakeCost --scenario idle-warehouse-waste --seed 9101 --output /tmp/idle-warehouse-waste.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/idle-warehouse-waste.snapshot.json --force from workspace root.
Verify the command exits with code 0 and creates both the normalized SQLite database and the canonical JSON snapshot.

Execute python3 -m pytest tests/test_idle_warehouse_waste.py -q -k test_snapshot_provenance_metadata to verify provenance metadata fields (packId, scenarioId, seed, dataForgeStoryContractPath, generatorVersion, generationTimestamp, synthetic, disclosure).
Confirm that snapshot exports conform strictly to the canonical SQLiteSnapshot contract with synthetic: true and disclosure text Synthetic demo data.

journeys.name: Enforce fail-closed overwrite protection and input validation for idle warehouse waste generation
journeys.goal: An operator confirms that existing output files are protected against accidental overwrites by failing closed with exit code 2 unless --force is explicitly provided, and verifies that missing arguments or invalid inputs fail cleanly without tracebacks.
steps: Run python3 -m pytest tests/test_idle_warehouse_waste.py -q -k test_cli_idle_warehouse_fail_closed to verify that existing output SQLite and snapshot JSON files abort with exit code 2 when --force is omitted.
Confirm the command outputs clean diagnostics indicating the target file already exists without unhandled Python stack traces.
Run python3 -m pytest tests/test_idle_warehouse_waste.py -q -k test_unknown_snowflake_cost_scenario_fails_cleanly to verify that unrecognized scenario names fail closed with exit code 2.
Confirm all input validation failures produce clean error diagnostics without raw tracebacks.

journeys.name: Validate DashboardSpec contract and DataAdapter runtime query seams for idle warehouse waste
journeys.goal: A mission or developer verifies that the idle-warehouse-waste slice adheres to the canonical DashboardSpec schema and resolves datasets through the DataAdapter runtime query and aggregation interface without introducing secondary rendering pipelines.
steps: Run python3 -m pytest tests/test_idle_warehouse_waste.py -q -k test_idle_warehouse_dashboardspec_meta_and_constants to verify DashboardSpec metadata and scenario identifiers.
Execute python3 -m pytest tests/test_idle_warehouse_waste.py -q -k test_all_seven_scenario_datasets_present_in_sqlite to confirm that all 7 required datasets exist and have rows in SQLite.

Run python3 -m pytest tests/test_idle_warehouse_waste.py -q -k test_idle_warehouse_adapter_query_routing_in_presentation to verify that presentation loaders query data strictly through the DataAdapter interface.

Confirm that the DataAdapter seam resolves queries across all seven required datasets (executive_summary, warehouse_metering_history, query_history, metering_history, database_storage_usage_history, show_warehouses, recommendation_queue).

journeys.name: Confirm scenario and template catalog registration for snowflakeCost idle-warehouse-waste
journeys.goal: A consultant or author confirms that the scenario catalog registers snowflakeCost:idle-warehouse-waste and the template catalog registers tpl.snowflakeCost.idle-warehouse-waste with pre-configured widgets, layouts, and dataset bindings.
steps: Run python3 -m pytest tests/test_idle_warehouse_waste.py -q -k test_scenario_catalog_registers_idle_warehouse_waste to confirm scenario catalog registration.
Run python3 -m pytest tests/test_idle_warehouse_waste.py -q -k test_template_catalog_registers_idle_warehouse_waste to confirm template catalog registration.
Run python3 -m pytest tests/test_idle_warehouse_waste.py -q -k test_dynamic_scenario_discovery_matches_dataforge to verify dynamic discovery from dataForge without hardcoded lists.
Verify that scenario entry snowflakeCost:idle-warehouse-waste and template entry tpl.snowflakeCost.idle-warehouse-waste are formally registered with full widget specifications and layouts.

journeys.name: Inspect prioritized and guarded recommendations from the recommendation queue dataset
journeys.goal: A FinOps consultant or buyer inspects the recommendation_queue dataset to verify that prioritized recommendations carry executive severity, suggested owners, actionable steps, evidence details, and safety guardrails requiring owner validation.
steps: Run python3 -m pytest tests/test_idle_warehouse_waste.py -q -k test_recommendation_queue_governance_columns_snapshot to verify governance columns.
Run python3 -m pytest tests/test_idle_warehouse_waste.py -q -k test_recommendation_queue_row_integrity to confirm valid severities, suggested owners, and non-empty actions.
Run python3 -m pytest tests/test_idle_warehouse_waste.py -q -k test_recommendation_queue_guardrail_directional_validation to confirm guardrail directional validation framing.
Confirm that recommendations enforce directional validation policies requiring owner confirmation before warehouse configuration changes.

journeys.name: Verify browser-visible standalone presentation, recommendation queue interaction, follow-up export, and synthetic disclosure integrity
journeys.goal: An executive presenter or client delivery lead verifies that the standalone browser-visible dashboard presents the idle warehouse narrative (opportunity metrics, idle counts, credit concentration, control gaps), unsuppressed Synthetic demo data disclosure, interactive recommendation queue, and same-day executive follow-up artifact.
commands: npm --prefix frontend test -- --run -t "renders controlled artifact evidence and citations through the shared runtime"
steps: Execute targeted frontend test npm --prefix frontend test -- --run -t "renders controlled artifact evidence and citations through the shared runtime" to verify browser-visible dashboard presentation, headline opportunities, recommendation queue interaction, and follow-up export triggers.
Execute python3 -m pytest tests/test_idle_warehouse_waste.py -q -k test_synthetic_disclosure_text to confirm the synthetic disclosure text.

Verify the executive narrative structure: headline monthly opportunity (726 credits), idle warehouse count (2 warehouses), credit usage concentration (FINANCE_REPORTING_WH > 50%), control gaps, and prioritized recommendations.
Confirm prominent, unsuppressed Synthetic demo data disclosure across UI and exported executive follow-up artifacts.

journeys.name: Verify regression immunity across existing packs and execute full automated test suite
journeys.goal: A human reviewer executes existing pack generation and the full automated test suite to confirm backwards compatibility for healthcare, financial, and SaaS packs with zero dataForge modifications and all tests green.
commands: env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack healthcare --scenario flu-season --seed 3101 --output /tmp/healthcare-flu.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/healthcare-flu.snapshot.json --force
steps: Generate a healthcare scenario using env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack healthcare --scenario flu-season --seed 3101 --output /tmp/healthcare-flu.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/healthcare-flu.snapshot.json --force to confirm existing packs remain operational.
Run python3 -m pytest tests/test_idle_warehouse_waste.py -q -k test_dataforge_unmodified to verify sibling repository dataForge remains strictly unmodified.
Execute python3 -m pytest tests/ -q with NO PYTHONPATH override from workspace root.
Confirm that all unit, integration, and regression tests pass cleanly without errors or regressions.
